message: IR contains a floating-point JSON number at V_path (starts with V_preview)
why: Canonical JSON forbids floats (IR.md P-1). The shortest round-trip representation of a float differs between Go, Rust and C++, so a float anywhere in the hashed bytes makes cross-language verification fail at random, and only on some machines.
fix: money and probabilities are integers — use micro-USD (1e-6) and basis points (1e-4)
